title: Jieqi, nearby, active: a dealt start with the evidence it was dealt
why: The one game whose start is dealt, in the one mode whose deal came from a handshake. start_fen is the deal itself — every hidden identity, ninety-nine characters, Red to move — and the three deal members beside it are what make the record checkable rather than asserted: the seed hashes to the commitment, and the deal that seed and nonce derive is the one the start spells. Validation re-derives it and compares, so a reader that skipped the derivation, ran Fisher-Yates the other way, or dropped the rejection sampling fails this file: deriving it draws a value of 0xfffffffd below nine, which is at the limit and must be discarded. The seed and nonce are plain on purpose, being a cross-implementation vector rather than a secret.
